description: Unit tests for the Orleans SiloInstanceManager utilizing Azure Storage for silo registration, activation, de-registration, cleanup, and data validation, leveraging Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of Orleans silo instance management using Azure Storage.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: A disposable fixture providing shared setup for the test class, mainly a logger factory.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, mainly disposing the logger factory.

methods.name: SiloInstanceTableManagerTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing test state, including cluster ID, silo address, and managing setup.

methods.name: RegisterSiloInstance
methods.description: Creates and registers a new silo instance entry for testing.

methods.name: FindSiloEntry
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a silo entry from the table based on the silo address.

methods.name: CheckSiloInstanceTableEntry
methods.description: Utility method for asserting equality of critical fields between expected and actual silo entries.
